title: T12 CHECK constraints reject live paper_v2 source enum values
description: Multiple CHECK constraints in T12 DDL accept lowercase enum values, but source paper_v2 stores uppercase RunStatus / order event_type values. Mismatches: paper_v2_run.status (lowercase pending/running/... vs SUCCEEDED/FAILED/...), paper_v2_order_event.event_type (lowercase placed/partial_fill/fill vs SUBMITTED/PARTIALLY_FILLED/FILLED/...). Plus deeper schema-level mismatches discovered in round-2 audit: paper_v2_cash_ledger.entry_type CHECK removed (source has NO entry_type column - handler must derive); paper_v2_config_change_audit.change_type was action vs subject confused (constraint renamed ck_..._action, accepts CREATE/ACTIVATE/DEACTIVATE/MODIFY); paper_v2_reset_audit.reset_type CHECK removed (source has NO reset_type - handler must derive); paper_v2_session_day.data_quality kept as 4-val CHECK (archive-derived field). Decision per brief: archive source enum values as-is, no transform layer. P1.4 of Codex T12+T14a review.
reproduce_command: psql -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5433 -d aistock_dev -f backend/db/init_qe_archive_paper_v2_extension_20260510.sql && python -c "# attempt insert with status='SUCCEEDED'"
